readerCopy.body: An unexpected change can solve a problem that seemed destined to require permanent workarounds. When Uranus trines the North Node, experimentation and forward movement reinforce each other, allowing technology, an unusual introduction, a schedule change, sudden opening, or different method to become genuinely useful to what comes next. A course correction can be progress without becoming a complete reinvention. The strongest option creates more freedom while preserving what still works.
